{
  "settings": [
    {
      "name": "unsafe_enable_version_guessing",
      "input_type": "BOOLEAN",
      "scope": "GLOBAL",
      "evidence": "Enable globbing the filesystem (if possible) to find the latest metadata version. This may read an uncommitted version, so it is disabled by default.",
      "default_kind": "literal",
      "default_value": "false",
      "default_evidence": "false"
    },
    {
      "name": "iceberg_use_metadata_log",
      "input_type": "BOOLEAN",
      "scope": "GLOBAL",
      "evidence": "Use a table's optional `metadata-log` to preserve atomicity guarantees, at the cost of an additional metadata `GET` in rare cases.",
      "default_kind": "literal",
      "default_value": "true",
      "default_evidence": "true"
    },
    {
      "name": "ignore_target_file_size_for_partitioned_tables",
      "input_type": "BOOLEAN",
      "scope": "GLOBAL",
      "evidence": "Ignore the unsupported `write.target-file-size-bytes` table property on partitioned tables instead of raising an error.",
      "default_kind": "literal",
      "default_value": "false",
      "default_evidence": "false"
    },
    {
      "name": "ignore_row_group_size_for_partitioned_tables",
      "input_type": "BOOLEAN",
      "scope": "GLOBAL",
      "evidence": "Ignore the unsupported `write.parquet.row-group-size-bytes` table property on partitioned tables instead of raising an error.",
      "default_kind": "literal",
      "default_value": "false",
      "default_evidence": "false"
    },
    {
      "name": "iceberg_via_aws_sdk_for_catalog_interactions",
      "input_type": "BOOLEAN",
      "scope": "GLOBAL",
      "evidence": "Use the legacy AWS SDK code path to interact with AWS-based catalogs instead of DuckDB's HTTP client.",
      "default_kind": "literal",
      "default_value": "false",
      "default_evidence": "false"
    }
  ]
}
